coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Park Terrace
record.summary: Park Terrace, an apartment building at 325 Berry St.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcels), so no single block/lot represents the whole building and it cannot be matched to one parcel record the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against DataSF's Assessor parcels in September 2026; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).

milestones.text: Park Terrace (325 Berry St) under construction, slated for completion by end of 2006
Park Terrace (325 Berry St) completed: the condominium lots carry year built 2007 in the DataSF Assessor roll

changes.text: The map notes gave 110 units and a 2007 build with only an OSM way cited, and said the developer was not confirmed. A dated note now cites SocketSite (May 2006: 110 units, seven stories, developers Opus West and Phoenix Property Company) and the DataSF Assessor roll (year built 2007). The 2006 and 2007 milestones cite those pages instead of a bare domain and an uncheckable listing, and the comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III.
